context_requirements: Expression of SLC6A4 (serotonin transporter) and/or other monoamine transporters
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage for robust transcriptional coupling to serotonin signaling
Functional downstream serotonin receptor signaling (HTR subtypes) and second messenger pathways
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of SLC6A4-mediated transcriptional response in a non-neuronal line
